name: CLI / automation tool
tagline: Python + Typer + SQLite, installed with pipx
why: Workflow and automation ideas are usually best as a sharp command-line tool: instant startup, scriptable, no server to run.
tradeoffs: Terminal-only audience; a UI later means a separate template.
avoid_when: Non-technical end users need to operate it.

build_order.title: Scaffold the tool
build_order.description: Typer app installs and runs with a help screen that makes sense.

build_order.title: Build the core commands
build_order.description: The must-have commands working against real files or data.

build_order.title: Persist state
build_order.description: SQLite or file storage for anything the tool must remember.

build_order.title: Polish and harden
build_order.description: Clear errors, edge cases, and green tests.

build_order.title: Package it
build_order.description: pipx-installable packaging and short usage docs.

testing_defaults.tiers: test-first command logic; tier 0-1 for packaging
